## Detailed Model Lineup & Technical Specifications

### 1. Isuzu D-Max Pickups
1. **TFR 87 Single Cab 4x2 1.9L:**
   - Engine: RZ4E-TC 1.9L 4-cylinder Turbo Diesel (150 HP @ 3,600 rpm, 350 Nm @ 1,800–2,600 rpm)
   - Transmission: 6-speed manual
   - Drivetrain: 4x2 rear-wheel drive
   - Payload: 1,200 kg+ cargo deck capacity
   - Price in Kenya: KES 3,890,000 – KES 4,450,000
   - Best for: Hardware, agriculture, logistics, delivery routes

2. **TFS 87 Single Cab 4x4 1.9L (Manual & Auto):**
   - Engine: RZ4E-TC 1.9L Turbo Diesel (150 HP, 350 Nm)
   - Drivetrain: 4x4 Shift-on-the-fly with low range & rear diff lock
   - Price in Kenya: KES 4,390,000 – KES 5,200,000
   - Best for: Remote farming, tea and coffee estates, rough terrain construction

3. **TFS 87 Double Cab 4x4 1.9L (Manual & Auto):**
   - Engine: RZ4E-TC 1.9L Turbo Diesel (150 HP, 350 Nm)
   - Seating: 5 passengers, dual air conditioning, infotainment
   - Price in Kenya: KES 5,850,000 – KES 6,450,000
   - Best for: Site engineers, commercial supervisors, dual-purpose family and business

4. **TFS 40 Double Cab 4x4 3.0L (Auto / V-Cross):**
   - Engine: 4JJ3-TCX 3.0L 4-cylinder Common Rail Turbo Diesel (190 HP @ 3,600 rpm, 450 Nm @ 1,600–2,600 rpm)
   - Transmission: 6-speed automatic with sequential sport shift
   - Safety: Isuzu IDAS (Autonomous Emergency Braking, Lane Departure Warning, Adaptive Cruise Control)
   - Price in Kenya: KES 7,800,000 – KES 8,900,000
   - Best for: Executives, demanding heavy off-road expeditions, fleet managers
